results.detail: Set gen_name (DTSX:34382) is (DT_WSTR,4)(DT_I4)gen_producttypeid + "-" + (DT_WSTR,12)(DT_I8)gen_bankaccountnumber, with errorRowDisposition and truncationRowDisposition FailComponent and length 17. Every row of the source reaches it before any filter: source -> Multicast -> Component Task Name -> Set gen_name. A non-numeric value or a cast overflow therefore fails the component and the data flow. All precedence constraints are Success with one incoming each (DTSX:82412-82427). No executable is disabled, no MaximumErrorCount/ForceExecutionResult override exists, and the package has no configuration. The population is gen_existinfile = 1 inner-joined to product and gen_customeraccounttype, row_number = 1 (DTSX:33252-33313). The ownership argument holds: the ambiguity rule plus the single-table 'from gen_fundmain with (nolock) where Gen_existinfile = 1' inside the Update Aggrigations SQL (DTSX:68399). The finding is framed conditionally.

The SQL (DTSX:33252-33314) is not filtered on existing links. The inner joins are product on productid = gen_fundtypename and gen_customeraccounttype on cat.gen_id = p.Gen_producttypeid and cat.gen_bankname = f.gen_bankname (the fund's bank). The WHERE is gen_existinfile = 1, and row_number partitions by f.gen_bankname, f.gen_bankaccountnumber, p.gen_producttypeid with num = 1. The create/update decision is the Get Customer Account Guid Lookup: Match goes to Multicast 1 (update), No Match to Multicast 2 (create). The ownership evidence is exact. DTSX:33310/33313 are the unqualified columns. DTSX:68399 is a single-table gen_fundmain query with Gen_existinfile. DTSX:2607 has p.productid. 0008:5652 has 'join Product p on p.ProductId = fm.gen_fundtypename' with Gen_fundmain fm.

These units check out. The chain order and Success-only constraints match DTSX:82412-82427. [1]: gen_etlvariable sets ServerName/OrganizationName/CrmMinimumDate; the system user is found by domainname like '%crmadmin%' and used as ModifiedBy (DTSX:29585). [9]: TransactionCurrency where CurrencyName = User::CurrencyName, a design value of 'שקל חדש' that nothing assigns, with ExchangeRate 1 where TransactionCurrencyId is null (DTSX:29-31, 79895-79896). [14]: the OnError script casts the String variable with (Guid) before Update/Create (DTSX:82604; variable DataType 8 at DTSX:41-42; .ToString() at DTSX:9869), so 'not proven' is correct. [15] is consistent with step 7.

Only funds with gen_existinfile = 1 that inner-join to product and gen_customeraccounttype are read (DTSX:33309-33313). An existing account is updated only when a compared field differs (Is Need To Update All / Is Need To Update All 1 == TRUE, DTSX:33634, 33667). [6]: the copy happens only from funds where both gen_paragraph14 and gen_employerconfirmation are not null; when several such funds are linked to an account, the source fund is not determined (DTSX:79889).

Dates To Local (DTSX:1697) converts the consulting dates of the account and the fund. The script (main.cs:36-65, five identical copies) always sets gen_customeraccountname, and sets each consulting field only when the account value is not null and the fund value is null or different.

[1] selection and ownership: DTSX:2609-2613, 68399. [2] the account type comes from the product and the product's bank (DTSX:2608), with exact account number (DTSX:2609). [3] gen_customeraccountname is always set (main.cs:40). [4]-[8] are the per-field rule !genX_IsNull && (fmX_IsNull || genX != fmX) (main.cs:42-65); a null value in the account leaves the fund value. [9] is conditional on a matching account and a successful update.

Units [1]-[13] are correct: the joins/WHERE (DTSX:2588-2613), the ownership argument, Dates To Local inputs (DTSX:1697: gen_consultingstartdate/enddate, fm_consultingstartdate/enddate), five identical script copies (DTSX:3110-8347), the field mapping (main.cs:42-65) and ExecuteMultiple Update in batches of 10. results.detail: Correct units: [1] the SQL (DTSX:77180-77213) is tr LEFT JOIN Gen_fundmain on tr.gen_customeraccount = fm.gen_customeraccountname, with type 5, status 8 (comments 'בין מסלולים'/'הסתיים') and gen_dateofcopyingconsultingdetailstofund is null. The ownership argument rests on the single-table 'update gen_transferrequest set gen_dateofcopyingconsultingdetailstofund = GETUTCDATE()' (DTSX:79598-79599). No supplied package creates gen_transferrequest (only updates in 0005, 0028:11114, 0029:40559, 0036:3886-3888), and 0036 updates only gen_tanferinstatus of status-7 requests. [2] There is no join to a specific fund; note that 0028:3382 reads a tr.gen_sourcefundnumber column, but its target is not shown and it is not used to join gen_fundmain. [3] the Derived Column ISNULL(tr_X) ? fm_X : tr_X; Update Fund Main 1-5 (identical SQL); success rows -> Aggregate on gen_transferrequestid -> Update TransferRequest (identical SQL), so a request is marked if at least one fund row succeeded. [4] direct UPDATEs through [qsql] (Unsupported). WRONG: [5] states unconditionally 'כשאין לחשבון קופות, הבקשה מסומנת בלי שעודכנה קופה'. With no fund, all fm.* are NULL, and the row is selected only if at least one tr consulting field is not null (DTSX:77207-77212). In that case Update Fund Main runs with Gen_fundmainId = NULL (0 rows, success) and the request is marked. A request with no funds and all six consulting fields empty is never selected and never marked.

wrongUnits.unit: [5] 'כשאין לחשבון קופות, הבקשה מסומנת בלי שעודכנה קופה.'
wrongUnits.problem: This is stated unconditionally. Without funds, the request is selected, and so marked, only if at least one of its six consulting fields is not null.
